how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application form Schedule-1 for individuals or Schedule-2 for self-help groups, women/ex-servicemen cooperative societies from the district website.

Attach self-attested copies of educational certificates, mark sheets, computer knowledge certificate, caste certificate, residential certificate, and character certificate or executive magistrate affidavit.

Make sure it reaches by 30 November 2026.

Matriculation (10th) pass and adult age. Computer knowledge will be given preference.

content_sections.heading: Collectorate Begusarai Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 02 / 2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download Collectorate Begusarai notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Matric pass; Must be an adult Age limit: Minimum 18 years Other conditions: Applicant must be a resident of the concerned panchayat or ward. Only one member in a joint family can be allotted a fair price shop. Elected representatives like Mukhiya, Sarpanch, Panch, Ward Member, Panchayat Samiti Member, Zilla Parishad Member, MLA, MLC, MP and urban body elected members are disqualified during their tenure. Flour mill owners and their close relatives cannot apply. Desirable: Computer knowledge

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for Collectorate Begusarai Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Minors, mentally unsound or bankrupt persons Persons convicted under the Essential Commodities Act 1955 or any criminal case by a final court order Persons holding an office of profit under the government

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Commission based as per Bihar Targeted Public Distribution System (Control) Order.

content_sections.heading: How Will Collectorate Begusarai Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Merit based on academic qualifications Priority given to Self Help Groups, women cooperative societies, ex-servicemen cooperative societies, educated unemployed, and local residents Selection will be made purely on merit basis. Priority order: (i) Self Help Groups (ii) Women cooperative societies (iii) Ex-servicemen cooperative societies (iv) Educated unemployed (v) Resident of concerned panchayat or ward.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Three recent passport size colored photographs Self-attested copies of educational certificates and mark sheets Self-attested copy of computer knowledge certificate Self-attested copy of caste certificate issued by Circle Officer Self-attested copy of character certificate or affidavit from executive magistrate not older than six months Affidavit sworn before executive magistrate regarding family members not holding PDS shop, non-holding of elected post, non-ownership of flour mill, and non-holding of office of profit

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Collectorate Begusarai Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Download the prescribed application form Schedule-1 for individuals or Schedule-2 for self-help groups, women/ex-servicemen cooperative societies from the district website. Fill in the application form with required details including panchayat/ward number and reservation category. Attach self-attested copies of educational certificates, mark sheets, computer knowledge certificate, caste certificate, residential certificate, and character certificate or executive magistrate affidavit. Send the application form along with 3 recent passport size colored photographs (one self-attested pasted on top right corner) strictly through registered post to the office of the Sub-Divisional Officer, Begusarai. Make sure it reaches by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Collectorate Begusarai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Collectorate Begusarai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 73 vacancies for Public Distribution System Dealer.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Collectorate Begusarai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (begusarai.bih.nic.in) and send it to Office of the Sub-Divisional Officer, Begusarai, Bihar, by registered post, to reach by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Commission based as per government rules.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Matriculation (10th) pass and adult age. Computer knowledge will be given preference.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicant must be a resident of the concerned panchayat or ward. Only one member in a joint family can be allotted a fair price shop. Elected representatives like Mukhiya, Sarpanch, Panch, Ward Member, Panchayat Samiti Member, Zilla Parishad Member, MLA, MLC, MP and urban body elected members are disqualified during their tenure. Flour mill owners and their close relatives cannot apply.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Minors, mentally unsound or bankrupt persons. Persons convicted under the Essential Commodities Act 1955 or any criminal case by a final court order. Persons holding an office of profit under the government.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Merit based on academic qualifications. Priority given to Self Help Groups, women cooperative societies, ex-servicemen cooperative societies, educated unemployed, and local residents. Selection will be made purely on merit basis. Priority order: (i) Self Help Groups (ii) Women cooperative societies (iii) Ex-servicemen cooperative societies (iv) Educated unemployed (v) Resident of concerned panchayat or ward.

faq.answer: Begusarai Sub-division, Begusarai.
